notes.content:
Patch Notes - Steam v0.10.70

Passive tree change!
The passive tree has been changed in a way that nodes that you click on are not finalized until you click the save button. Instead they are put into a planner mode which allows for planning, exporting, and importing the tree.

[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*] Change: Unity engine updated from 2022LTS to Unity 6. 
[*] Bugfix: Clicking a button with a tooltip no longer causes the tooltip to show up after and linger.
[*] Bugfix: Crash on reorganizing the logger fixed.
[/list]

[b]Passive:[/b]
[list]
[*] New: The way the passive tree is interacted with has changed.
[*] Change: Default colors for node links has been darkened.
[*] Bugfix: Node line connection width should scale with zoom level again. This was disabled due to a compiler restriction.
[/list]

[b]Arena:[/b]

[*] Balance: Skill Fury now rolls between 20-40 from 5-15.

[*] Added: Some fighters will now have + 15% crit chance and + 100% crit damage.
[*] Added: Some fighters will now have Skill: Summon Skeleton.
[/list]


[b]Advanced Combat:[/b]
[list]
[*] New: Active Skill: Shield Smash - Damage is based off your armor, Strikes one opponent.
[*] New: Passive Skill: Temporal Shift - Stores 1 hit's worth of damage and combines it with the next. The stored damage is then reduced.
[*] New: Life Steal has been added to the game. (Regenerate a % of damage dealt as life)
[*] UI: Minion skills now display their number of minions on the buff icon.
[*] Bugfix: Enemy can no longer use the players "Absolute Charges" affix.
[*] Bugfix: Multi-Attack now is seperated from Multi-Action.
[*] Bugfix: Basic Attack buff tooltip now includes affix "Multiplier to Basic Attack Damage".
[*] Bugfix: Skill Mark applying stacks twice.
[*] Bugfix: Skill Marked not displaying stack count.
[*] Bugfix: Skill Infectious Attack now scales off Basic Attack damage instead of Fighter Damage.
[*] Bugfix: Skill Heavy now uses the projects damage multiplier again.
[*] Bugfix: Skill Heavy tooltip now includes physical damage multiplier.
[/list]

[b]Clicker:[/b]
[list]
[*] UI: Clicker upgrades now show their current bonus if the level is higher than 1. 
[*] Bugfix: Bought upgrades now show the correct level of the upgrade.
[/list]


[b]Inventory:[/b]
[list]
[*] Balance: The way affixes with potential roll value caps have changed.
  > Skill rolls for skills Might, Heavy, Infectious Attack, Magic Missile and Second Wind now roll within a specified range.
  > There are 5 tiers of the rolls involving a 20% difference between min/max rolls of the affix.
[*] UI: The selected unique in the Armory is now more easily viewable.
 
[b]Kingdom:[/b]
[*] New: Project Damage Over Time, Unlocked by having at least 10% Increased Damage Over Time.
[*] New: Project Minion Damage, Unlocked by having any minion skill.
[*] New: Building, Hero Statue. Grants multiplier to Hero Experience Gained.

notes.content:
Patch Notes - Steam v0.9.67


[b]Arena:[/b]
[list]
[*] Balance: Multiplier to Module Experience gain increased to 1.2, from 1.1 when actively playing the arena.
[*] Balance: Multiplier to Item Find Rating increased to 1.2, from 1.1 when actively playing the arena.
[/list]


[b]Advanced Combat:[/b]
[list]
[*] New: Skill Harden Up - Grants a Shell charge when taking a significant hit. (Significant hits deal at least 10% of a fighters health)
[*] New: Skill Summon Skeleton - Summons a skeleton minion that will fight alongside the fighter.
[*] New: Skill Summon Wolf - Summons a wolf minion that will fight alongside the fighter, Always inflicts bleed.
[*] New: Skill Summon Bats - Summons a bat minion that will fight alongside the fighter. Summon a horde.
[*] New: Diseased has been implemented as an Necrotic Ailment.
[*] New: Dungeon now has extra details for fighters my click and holding over the fighters info block.
[*] Balance: Skill: Hand of Hir'Rile has its damage increased based on the fighters Lightning Resistance.
[*] Balance: Skill: Hand of Hir'Rile now applies shock to the opponent.
[*] Balance: Poison Debuff stack scaling has been buffed to use Log division of the stack count, Instead of just division of the stack count.
[*] Balance: Skill: Head Start is no longer chance based. Instead now consistently makes the fighters first action faster.
[*] Balance: Individual elements now have their own indidividual resistances. Resistances have been changed.
[*]  > Magic Resistance will only increase a restance up to 40%.
[*]  > Elemental Resistance will only increase a resistance up to 60%.
[*]  > Individual resistance will increase up to 80%.
[*]  Bugfix: Basic Attack now shows as a buff again.
[*] Bugfix: Fire, Cold, Lightning, Holy and Necrotic damage multipliers was incorrectly being applied twice. 
[*] Bugfix: Elemental Damage bonus wasn't correctly applying to Fire, Cold or Lightning.
[*] Bugfix: All forms of Fire/cold/lightning/holy/necrotic resistance was missing functionality.
[*] Bugfix: Skill: Fury is an passive skill again
[*] Bugfix: Skill: Heavy now starts at 1.0 multiplier again.
[*] Bugfix: Skill: Head Start was not checking the chance to activate.
[*] Bugfix: Additional Multi-Action should now work from non-racial traits.
[*] Bugfix: Skills now properly apply base damage when using Skill Priority.
[*] Bugfix: Skills are no longer considered Basic Attacks when using Skill Priority.
[*] Bugfix: Skill: Hand of Hir'Rile now damages the caster for 33% of the damage dealt.
[*] UI: Most Buff tooltips are now 250 wide compared to 200. Some are now customized larger.4
[/list]


[b]Explore:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bugfix: Explore progress now works from all sources instead of just RACE.
[/list]
  
[b]Hero:[/b]
[list]
[*] New: Toggle unlocked at Expedition level 1000 that enables faster catching up to your best Expedition level.
[*] Balance: Expedition enemy level gain rate is now based on the square root of the highest level beat.
[/list]


[b]Dungeon:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bugfix: Skill Priority down button now works.
[*] Bugfix: Skill Priority no longer needs to be double-clicked to fix new skills from showing.
[*] Bugfix: Skill Priority loadout numbers and positions should update correctly now.
[*] Bugfix: On loading the game, Skill priority now works without requiring the player to open the window once.
[/list]


[b]Inventory:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed: Affix Additional Rank of All Inventory Rolled Items, And the 7 item type affixes associated.
[*] Added: Affix % Increased Level of Newly Created items, And 7 more for the associated item types.
[*] Balance: Rings Normal loot table roll Additional Hero Health value increased to 2.5, from 2.
[*] Balance: Rings Normal loot table roll Additional Hero Damage value increased to 1.25, from 1.
[*] Balance: Rings Normal loot table roll Additional Magic Find value increased to 2, from 1.5.
[*] Balance: Cloak Normal loot table roll Additional Magic Find value increased to 2, from 1.5.
[*] Balance: Cloak Normal loot table roll Additional Crit Damage Rating value increased to 2, from 1.
[*] Balance: Cloak Normal loot table removed roll Endurance.
[*] Balance: Cloak Normal loot table removed roll Wisdom.
[*] Balance: Cloak Normal loot table removed roll Intelligence.
[/list]

Balance: Cloak Normal loot table % Increased attribute roll weight increased to 225, from 175.
Balance: Cloak Normal loot table roll % Increased All Attributes weight increased to 50, from 20.
Balance: Chest Normal loot table weight re-balanced. Higher chance of Endurance/Toughness attirbutes.
Balance: Chest Normal loot table added roll Additional Hero Armor with a value of 1.25 and weight 400. (1 in 113, 0.87% chance)
Balance: Unique Hand of Hir'Rile now has ranged based rolls as the item scaled too well.
Bugfix: Legendary items can now be rolled again. (Unique update stopped legendary items from rolling)
Bugfix: Unique Front Liner Shell Charge on Basic Attack can now roll a proper number.

[b]Kingdom:[/b]
Removed: Leather Project.
Bugfix: Renamed all instances of Kingdom Soldier Health to Soldier Health.
Bugfix: Renamed all instances of Kingdom Soldier Attack to Soldier Attack.
Bugfix: Renamed all instances of Soldier Damage to Soldier Attack.
Bugfix: Conquering army size multipliers now correctly work.

Bugfix: Reset Multiplier is now Added to the multiplier.

notes.title: Playtest and plans
notes.content:
[h1]Playtest[/h1]

Multi Idle will soon be opening to a public PlayTest through steams PlayTest feature.
There is currently plans for roughly 500 players at first, with more space opening after depending on feedback, bugs, and the number of player drop-offs.

[h1]What to expect with PlayTest[/h1]
For those that already have access, Content will be roughly the same but with QoL additions.. But for players that are entering the PlayTest they will be granted the exact same build as what is currently being released to players. Current game updates have been reserved to just Quality of Life, Visual improvements and bug fixes for this time, With content updates soon after the PlayTest.

[h1]Content to expect[/h1]
There's a lot of features and mechanics that will be introduced. After the PlayTest, when updates start being more content driven again, there will hopefully be a passive addition of skills. Somewhere shortly after, I will also restructure the center of the passive tree. It won't be a full refactoring of the passive tree but mainly just how players start. Players will select one of six starting locations in the center, which just dictates which node your passives begin from. You can always double back around to another starting node, but may not be worth the point investment. 

From there we will likely have a decision to make regarding what content comes after, but to list some out:
[list]
[*][b]Roguelite[/b] - Will be inside the dungeon module, and will be a system that will use a resource to either start a RogueLite run or move forward to the next room within it. Every run will begin at room 1, and increment with every room similar to how the dungeon stages work. The fighter used in this feature will also begin at level 1. Between every room, the player will be able to choose a bonus that will be applied to that run. These bonuses include things like levels to the fighter's level, increased damage, armor and health of the fighter, and more. With the fighter used in this feature being very secluded to itself, he will not be getting the benefit of many bonuses available to the normal dungeon fighter except a lesser bonus based on the player's current multiplier. There will be benefits given to the player at the end of each run depending on how far they've gotten.

[*][b]Raids[/b] - Players will use either all three of their characters. Or the currently selected fighter with two other Pre-Configured fighters scaled with your character's current multiplier. The player will then fight a difficult dungeon boss with absurdly high health! A very even fight will likely last a whole minute. When a boss is defeated, the next boss will then spawn and with a much higher difficulty. There will be multiple different types of bosses, each with their own respawn times. There is going to be a time limit on the fights, likely somewhere between 60 to 120 seconds. When all of the player's fighters die or their time runs out, rewards will be given based on how many bosses they've defeated.

[*][b]Arena[/b] - Some players may not have experienced this since there has been a large bug with it recently and a large focus being pointed to other focuses of the game. If the arena is not working this time around then we will get it fully working with the full implementation on the way. The arena will allow players to create a configuration of a fighter. What that means is that we'll give them 100 points to increase stats like health, level, crit chance, and other such elements. As well as 100 passive points for a customization of their tree. And maybe a few other possibilities like a few set ups of equipment. From there the players' fighters will go into a queue where two of the fighters will then fight against each other. Every player both fighting and in the queue will see the same fight, and those in the queue can bet on who will win using arena money. After 64 unique player fighters have passed and been declared a winner, The winners will then fight in a tournament style bracket to decide who has the best fighter!

[*][b]Some others[/b] - There will be other things like Wonders, large buildings to be constructed in the Kingdom. Players will have to rebuild every rebirth however each Wonder will come with a very large reward.
There is a card system that will be used as a strategic form of play since there will be a field that you can place cards onto that will have various effects and can change depending on the cards that are adjacent to it.
And finally the 'after everything that has been said is done', there will be Space and Worlds, Spaceship building, fighting, and more!

[/list]
